name: Suzuka International Racing Course
description: Honda's figure of eight in Japan, the only one that crosses over itself. The Esses, Degner, the Hairpin, Spoon and the flat-out 130R.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1391 of 2322 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
